extracted.intended_audience: researchers, students, policymakers, and general readers seeking country-level demographic statistics (e.g., CIA World Factbook users)
extracted.subtask_description: Extract and interpret per-country demographic metrics (life expectancy, literacy rates, military-available population) as reported in a country statistics/reference dataset. Includes recognizing definition notes, years of estimate, and NA/missing values.

rubrics_metrics.name: Life expectancy at birth (years)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-country estimates reporting life expectancy at birth, typically given as 'total population', 'male', and 'female' values with the year of estimate (e.g., 'total population: 64.05 years; male: 62.48 years; female: 65.7 years (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Values are presented per country and often include separate male/female breakdowns. Entries may show 'NA' when data are unavailable. Each value is accompanied by the year and labeled as an estimate (e.g., '(2004 est.)'). The page notes its last update date ('This page was last updated on 10 February, 2005'), which should be used when assessing currency.

rubrics_metrics.name: Literacy (%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-country literacy rates presented as percentages for 'total population', 'male', and 'female', often preceded by a 'definition' line specifying the literacy definition used for that country (e.g., 'definition: age 15 and over can read and write'). Each country entry usually includes the year of the estimate (e.g., '(2003 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The 'definition' field varies by country (examples: 'age 15 and over can read and write', 'age 9 and over can read and write', 'has ever attended school', or 'NA'), so users must interpret rates in light of differing definitions and age thresholds. Years differ across countries and some entries show 'NA'. Notes appear occasionally (e.g., 'note: probably the same as Denmark proper'). Use the provided definition when comparing literacy rates across countries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Military manpower - availability
rubrics_metrics.description: Per-country counts of the population available for military service, typically presented as 'males age 15-49' (and in some entries both 'males' and 'females' age 15-49) with the year of estimate (e.g., 'males age 15-49: 6,785,414 (2004 est.)').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries list numeric counts by country and specify the age range used (commonly 15-49). Some entries include both sexes; others only males. Values are followed by the estimate year. Missing data may be present for some territories. Treat these as availability estimates, not current active-duty personnel counts.
